name: Notice of Production of Non-Public Record
description: When the District produces a record that is not a public record, the provider, the subject, and the requester are notified.
recipient: Third party that provided the record, subject of the record, and requester
quote: When the District produces a record that is not a public record in response to a request, the Open Records Officer shall notify any third party that provided the record to the District, the person that is the subject of the record and the requester.
